scene_target: Rhea decrypts the coordinate data and formulates a plan to inject a corrupted ledger entry into the administrative hub.
goal: Decrypt the coordinate data and formulate a counter-attack plan before the mob breaks through.
conflict: Vance is at 10 HP holding the door against a respawning mob while Rhea races against time to decrypt the data with 1 Stamina.
end_condition: Rhea successfully decrypts the exact location and declares the plan to inject a corrupted ledger entry, preparing the party to move.
location_end: Inside the ruined tollbooth, preparing to leave.
transition_in_text: As the hounds begin to respawn outside, Vance braces against the door while Rhea focuses on the newly acquired coordinate data.
transition_out_text: With the destination locked and a desperate plan formed, the party prepares to break out of the tollbooth and head for the administrative hub.

persona_updates: Rhea realizes she can weaponize the overseer's Audit Compliance tag to bypass the hub's firewall and crash the local node.
Vance is surviving on a razor's edge, trusting Rhea's insane plan to crash the system because it's his only chance of survival.

chapter_so_far_add: Rhea successfully decrypted the coordinates to the administrative hub and formulated a plan to inject a corrupted ledger entry to bankrupt the overseer.
key_events: Vance braced the door with his Rebar, holding off the hounds at 10 HP.
Rhea used Unit 734 to interface with the dead terminal and decrypt the Administrative Coordinate Chip.
Rhea weaponized the Red-Tier Audit Compliance tag to bypass the secondary encryption layer.
The decryption completed, revealing the location of the administrative hub.
Rhea declared her plan to use the Raw Data Packet to trigger a catastrophic default on the overseer's ledger.
